comparisons.name: states-light
comparisons.description: The state fixture at rest: Blue chosen, Purple, a swatch of another colour, and a disabled picker, Aqua.

pixels.note: centre dot of the chosen swatch (spec: Dot, measured)
Blue fill (spec: swatch table, sRGB, measured)
flat pixel of Blue's 1 pt edge (spec: swatch table, ring, measured)
Purple fill (spec: swatch table, measured)
a swatch of any other colour is filled with the colour given
its edge: black at 20% over the fill, the ratio of the eight measured Aqua edges to their fills (computed)
disabled: Red #e0383f at half opacity over #ececec (spec: States, disabled; inferred)
disabled and chosen: the white dot at half opacity over #ececec (inferred)

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light

no ring around the next swatch

comparisons.name: focus-ring-purple-light

the Blue swatch is still blue (measured: the row is the same in all sixteen accent screenshots)

comparisons.name: appearance-light
comparisons.description: Appearance thumbnails of System Preferences > General, Aqua, Light chosen. The pictures are Apple artwork, which the library does not ship, and the captions are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms: both are masked, leaving the accent ring, the hairlines around the other pictures and their placement.
